run_projx_integrator: run the projx_integrator ODE solver with euler, midpoint, or rk4 method on a manifold
run_projx_integrator_return_last: run the projx_integrator_return_last ODE solver to get only the final state with lower memory
review_euler_step: review the euler_step function that performs a single Euler integration step on a manifold or Euclidean space
review_midpoint_step: review the midpoint_step function that performs a single midpoint integration step with optional manifold transport
review_rk4_step: review the rk4_step function that performs a single Runge-Kutta 4th order integration step in Euclidean space
